title: Presidential candidates' schedule for this Monday (24)
subtitle: Check out the planned activities for the contenders for the Planalto Palace this Monday (24).
excerpt: See the official schedule of the presidential candidates for this Monday (24), featuring interviews and preparations.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Candidates' official commitments

The schedule of the presidential candidates this Monday (24) focuses on interviews and Q&A sessions with the press. The contenders for the highest office in the Executive branch are also dedicating the day to activities aimed at preparing for the electoral campaign.

In addition to the interviews, strategic communication actions and media training sessions are scheduled for the contenders for the Planalto Palace, as disclosed for this Monday (24).

Preparation and the press

The electoral period is marked by intense movement by the candidates in search of media exposure and the alignment of communication strategies. Interviews and Q&A sessions play the role of exposing proposals and ideas to voters, while media training prepares participants for ongoing contact with media outlets.

With information from Agência Brasil.
